title: Digital-asset service provider due diligence file
definition: The customer identification and due diligence file a digital-asset service provider holds on the customer, together with the screening results and the source-of-funds record. It is requested where digital-asset activity is part of the picture, and it establishes what the provider actually verified, which is usually the only verification that exists.
evidence_to_cite: the due diligence file, with the date the relationship began
the identity verification performed and its outcome
the screening results, with the list versions and the dates screened

sources.citation: Money services business customer identification requirements, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
